test_cases.title: Start of Mission in Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No active communication session exists. RBC contact information is stored.

steps.action: Initiate the Start of Mission procedure.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Trackside order triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No active communication session exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an 'Establish Communication Session' order.

steps.action: Receive the trackside order to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Manual level change to Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. No active communication session exists.

steps.action: Driver manually changes the level to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Engine rear end reaching end of radio hole triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Train is exiting an announced radio hole. No active communication session exists.

steps.action: Simulate the engine rear end reaching the end of the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Loss of safe radio connection triggers re-establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. An active communication session exists. Safe radio connection is lost.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection such that the previous session is considered terminated.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a new communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Driver manual RBC selection outside SoM triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Outside Start of Mission procedure. No active communication session exists.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Session establishment sequence with compatible version
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session. Trackside is available and supports a compatible system version.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection.

steps.action: Safe radio connection is established.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'Initiation of communication session'.

steps.action: OBU receives the system version from trackside.
steps.expected: OBU considers the session established and sends a 'Session established report'.

test_cases.title: Session establishment with incompatible version
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session. Trackside sends an incompatible system version.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment and receive an incompatible system version.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'No compatible version supported', informs the driver, and terminates the session.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Trackside order specifies an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using FRMCS.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver choice at SoM
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Driver elected to use only GSM-R during SoM.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment after SoM where driver selected GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using GSM-R.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored preferred system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. No trackside order or specific driver single-radio choice applies. Previous session used FRMCS.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using FRMCS (the preferred system from the previous session).

test_cases.title: Memorization of successful radio system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Session establishment is triggered.

steps.action: Establish a communication session successfully using GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU stores GSM-R as the radio system used for the successful safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to End of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested).

steps.action: Perform End of Mission while session establishment is ongoing.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an order to terminate the communication session.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to terminate the communication session while establishment is ongoing.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to Level 2 exit
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress. Train is in Level 2 area.

steps.action: Simulate the train's min safe rear end passing a level transition border from Level 2 to an area where Level 2 is not supported.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Use stored RBC contact info for 'last known RBC' order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored RBC contact information (Identity: RBC-A, Phone: 123).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with RBC identity 'Last Known RBC' and telephone number 456.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with 'Last Known RBC' identity and phone 456.
steps.expected: OBU disregards phone 456 and uses stored contact information (RBC-A, Phone: 123) to establish the session.

test_cases.title: Ignore 'last known RBC' order when no contact info stored
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has no stored RBC contact information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with RBC identity 'Last Known RBC'.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with 'Last Known RBC' identity.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU prevents duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (setup in progress).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., driver selects 'Start' or receives trackside order).

steps.action: Initiate a trigger to establish a communication session with RBC-A while the initial session setup is still in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing setup process continues or is handled according to single-session logic, but no parallel/duplicate session is opened.

test_cases.title: OBU prevents new session with same RBC after established session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No Termination message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual level change or trackside order).

steps.action: Initiate a trigger to establish a communication session with RBC-A while the current session is active.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains the active one.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates existing session when establishing new one with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish a session with RBC-B (different from RBC-A).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU supports multiple sessions or is configured to switch. RBC-B is a different RBC than RBC-A.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the existing session with RBC-A (sends Termination of Communication Session message or equivalent action per §3.5.5.2).

steps.action: Observe the session establishment process with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU maintains existing session during RBC transition to Accepting RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A (Handing Over RBC) is established and active. An RBC transition order is received indicating RBC-B as the Accepting RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order embedded with order to establish session with Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU can handle multiple sessions or is in a state where it does not need to terminate the current session immediately to establish the new one (i.e., not forced by single-session GSM-R limitation requiring immediate switch).

steps.action: Receive the RBC transition order containing the instruction to establish a session with the Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT terminate the existing session with RBC-A immediately. It begins establishing a session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise info validity based on crossing direction in SL mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is set to Forward. A balise group is located ahead in the Forward direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data valid for 'Forward' direction (matching crossing direction).

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Forward direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information from the balise group, as it is valid for the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores balise info valid for opposite direction in SL mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is set to Forward. A balise group is located ahead in the Forward direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data valid only for 'Reverse' direction (opposite to crossing direction).

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Forward direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information from the balise group, as it is valid only for the opposite direction.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise info validity based on crossing direction in PS mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Passive Shunting (PS) mode. Train orientation is set to Reverse. A balise group is located ahead in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data valid for 'Reverse' direction (matching crossing direction).

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in PS mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information from the balise group, as it is valid for the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise info validity based on crossing direction in SH mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is set to Forward. A balise group is located ahead in the Forward direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data valid for 'Both' directions.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Forward direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information from the balise group, as it is valid for both directions.

test_cases.title: OBU applies new MA request parameters immediately if condition met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = 10s. Last MA request sent 12 seconds ago. New MA request parameters received from RBC: Repetition = 10s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately sends an MA request to the RBC, because the time since the last MA request (12s) is greater than or equal to the newly received repetition period (10s).

test_cases.title: OBU does not send immediate MA request if condition not met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = 10s. Last MA request sent 5 seconds ago. New MA request parameters received from RBC: Repetition = 10s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send an immediate MA request. It updates its internal parameters and waits for the next repetition interval (10s) to elapse from the last request.

test_cases.title: OBU does not define SvL while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero. There are potential SvL candidates (e.g., Danger Point) within the supervised area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement within the LOA.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's Supervised Location (SvL) status while the train is within the LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any Supervised Location (SvL). The SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are not used as SvL.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling speed restriction valid until new one received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is received and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new speed restriction received initially. Then, a new signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h is received.

steps.action: Wait for a period without receiving any new speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the previous restriction and applies the new 60 km/h speed restriction immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling speed restriction valid after switching to Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is received and active. OBU switches to Level 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Level 2 MA not yet accepted.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h signalling related speed restriction.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (or is replaced by Level 2 supervision logic), as the Level 2 MA has been accepted.

test_cases.title: OBU applies Maximum Train Speed as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: Train configuration allows a maximum speed of 200 km/h. No other speed restrictions are active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed increased towards 200 km/h.

steps.action: Increase train speed to 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to reach 200 km/h, treating it as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

steps.action: Attempt to increase train speed above 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU intervenes to prevent the train from exceeding 200 km/h, enforcing the Maximum Train Speed limit.

test_cases.title: OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as initial state for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where no speed restrictions have been computed from trackside data (initial state).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's speed supervision logic for permitted braking distance.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply any permitted-braking-distance limit to constrain the train speed, as the initial state is 'no speed restriction'.

test_cases.title: OBU resumes 'no speed restriction' state when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is applying a speed restriction based on trackside data. Trackside sends an order to resume the initial state.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume initial state.

steps.action: Receive the trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU stops applying the previous speed restriction and reverts to the 'no speed restriction' state, removing any permitted-braking-distance limit.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt after safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the trackside using a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). The OBU is in a state where it can monitor radio status.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection via EURORADIO interface.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for reconnection.

steps.action: Trigger a loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO while the communication session is active.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system that was previously used.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's radio interface activity.
steps.expected: The reconnection attempt is observed to use the correct radio system (matching the one stored from the previous successful setup).

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated due to timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost. The defined time for maintaining the session (as per A.3.1) is known and can be monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. No successful reconnection occurs within the defined time.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session maintenance is short enough for practical testing or can be adjusted in the test environment.

steps.action: Trigger a loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Wait until the defined time for maintaining the session expires without a successful reconnection.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's radio interface activity after the session termination.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection for this specific session context.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with an RIU. The safe radio connection is lost. The OBU has received an RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Train movement simulation passing the specified location.
test_cases.assumptions: The train position can be simulated to pass the specific location indicated in the RIU order.

steps.action: Trigger a loss of the safe radio connection while the OBU is before the RIU termination location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop upon successful reconnection
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Successful reconnection simulation.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio environment allows for a successful reconnection after the initial loss.

steps.action: Trigger a loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the OBU to successfully establish a new safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection once the connection is successfully set up.

test_cases.title: OBU başlatır: RBC'den gelen komut üzerine oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU ve RBC arasında aktif bir iletişim oturumu vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen 'Oturum sonlandırma' komutu.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen 'Oturum sonlandırma' komutu OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını RBC'ye gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen onay (acknowledgement) beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, onay mesajını alır ve oturumu sonlandırır. Sonraki mesaj gönderilmez.

test_cases.title: OBU başlatır: RBC komutu olmadan sonlandırma koşulu oluştuğunda
test_cases.preconditions: OBU ve RBC arasında aktif bir iletişim oturumu vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: SUBSET-026'da tanımlı bir sonlandırma koşulu (örneğin, sürücü tarafından Stand-By moduna geçiş ve RBC'den açık komut gelmemesi).
test_cases.assumptions: Test senaryosu, RBC'den açık bir sonlandırma komutu gelmeden sonlandırma koşulunun sağlandığı bir durumu simüle eder.

steps.action: OBU'da SUBSET-026'da tanımlı bir sonlandırma koşulu sağlanır (örneğin, sürücü Stand-By moduna geçer).
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'den açık bir komut almadan 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen onay (acknowledgement) beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, onay mesajını alır ve oturumu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: OBU başlatmaz: RBC komutu veya sonlandırma koşulu yoksa
test_cases.preconditions: OBU ve RBC arasında aktif bir iletişim oturumu vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hiçbir sonlandırma komutu veya koşulu sağlanmaz.

steps.action: OBU, RBC'den sonlandırma komutu almadan ve sonlandırma koşulu oluşmadan normal çalışmaya devam eder.
steps.expected: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajı göndermez. Oturum aktif kalır.

test_cases.title: Tekrar: Onay gelmediğinde 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajının tekrarı
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını göndermiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den onay (acknowledgement) gelmez.
test_cases.assumptions: Sabit bekleme süresi (fixed waiting time) ve tekrar sayısı (defined number of repetitions) Appendix A.3.1'e göre tanımlıdır.

steps.action: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj RBC'ye iletilir.

steps.action: Sabit bekleme süresi dolana kadar RBC'den onay beklenir.
steps.expected: Onay gelmez.

steps.action: Sabit bekleme süresi dolduğunda OBU'nun davranışı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını tekrar gönderir.

test_cases.title: Tekrar: Onay gelmediğinde mesajın tekrarının sabit bekleme süresiyle yapılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını göndermiştir ve onay gelmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den onay (acknowledgement) gelmez.
test_cases.assumptions: Sabit bekleme süresi (fixed waiting time) Appendix A.3.1'de tanımlıdır.

steps.action: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını tekrar gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj RBC'ye iletilir.

steps.action: Sabit bekleme süresinden önce RBC'den onay beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni bir mesaj göndermez.

steps.action: Sabit bekleme süresi dolduğunda OBU'nun davranışı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını tekrar gönderir.

test_cases.title: Oturum sonlandırma: Tanımlı tekrar sayısına ulaşıldığında ve onay gelmediğinde
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını tanımlı sayıda kez tekrarlamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den onay (acknowledgement) gelmez.
test_cases.assumptions: Tanımlı tekrar sayısı (defined number of repetitions) Appendix A.3.1'de tanımlıdır.

steps.action: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını son kez gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj RBC'ye iletilir.

steps.action: Sabit bekleme süresi dolana kadar RBC'den onay beklenir.
steps.expected: Onay gelmez.

steps.action: Sabit bekleme süresi dolduğunda OBU'nun durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumunun sonlandırıldığını kabul eder. Oturum kapatılır.

test_cases.title: Oturum sonlandırma: Tanımlı tekrar sayısına ulaşıldığında ve onay geldiğinde
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını tanımlı sayıda kez tekrarlamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den onay (acknowledgement) gelir.
test_cases.assumptions: Tanımlı tekrar sayısı (defined number of repetitions) Appendix A.3.1'de tanımlıdır.

steps.action: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu sonlandırma' mesajını son kez gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj RBC'ye iletilir.

steps.action: Sabit bekleme süresi dolmadan RBC'den onay beklenir.
steps.expected: Onay gelir.

steps.action: OBU'nun durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumunun sonlandırıldığını kabul eder. Oturum kapatılır.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The OBU has a valid GSM-R Radio Network identity stored or configured.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the stored GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where driver input is accepted. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the newly entered GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and communicating with trackside. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside containing a GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Receive a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network identity.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Default Radio Network type used when no memorised type exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. The OBU's non-volatile memory has been cleared or is in a state where no Radio Network type is memorised (simulating first power-up or system failure recovery).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a default Radio Network type configured in its on-board settings.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board for its operations.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only FRMCS is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. The FRMCS on-board is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has NOT elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal IS registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has NOT elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board IS registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when selected single radio system not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver HAS elected to perform the mission with only one radio system (e.g., FRMCS). The selected FRMCS on-board is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with min and max safe front ends
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train is moving. Reference Balise Group (LRBG) has a known location accuracy.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location accuracy of LRBG = 5m. Over-reading amount = 2m. Under-reading amount = 3m. Estimated front end position = 100m from LRBG.
test_cases.assumptions: No consist-length-related situations are active. The OBU allows inspection of min/max safe front end positions.

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: Min safe front end = Estimated front end - (Location Accuracy + Under-reading amount) = 100 - (5 + 3) = 92m.

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled

steps.action: Record the initial displayed geographical position (track kilometre) when the train is at the reference location.
steps.expected: The displayed position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value.

steps.action: Move the train in the reverse direction by a known distance (e.g., 50 meters) and wait for the position update.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is stationary. The OBU is in a mode where Roll Away Protection supervision is active or about to be activated. The National/Default Value for roll-away distance is known (e.g., 10 m).
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for roll-away distance: 10 m. Initial estimated position: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to read the calculated remaining distance and the virtual position parameters.

steps.action: Trigger the start of Roll Away Protection supervision (e.g., by entering a mode that activates it or by a specific test command).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled. The remaining distance should be equal to the National/Default Value (10 m) minus the estimated distance travelled since start (0 m). The displayed/calculated remaining distance is 10 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 2 m (simulated via odometer input).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance. The remaining distance is now 10 m - 2 m = 8 m.

steps.action: Move the train in the reversing direction by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining reversing distance to 40 m.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start with National Value
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode prior to Staff Responsible (e.g., Full Supervision). The National/Default Value for SR distance is known (e.g., 1000 m). No valid train position relative to balise groups is stored (or it is irrelevant for this virtual position calculation).
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for SR distance: 1000 m. Odometer under-reading: 0 m. Odometer over-reading: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows entry into Staff Responsible mode and inspection of virtual position parameters (estimated, min safe, max safe front end positions).

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of the SR distance. A virtual train front position is created. The remaining distance from the estimated front end to the end of the SR distance is 1000 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the virtual position. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 900 m. The remaining distance from the max safe front end is 900 m (assuming 0 over-reading). The remaining distance from the min safe front end is 900 m (assuming 0 under-reading).

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Staff Responsible mode. The SR distance is 1000 m. The odometer has a known under-reading amount of 5 m since the supervision started.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance: 1000 m. Distance travelled (odometer): 100 m. Odometer under-reading: 5 m. Odometer over-reading: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows setting or simulating odometer under/over-reading values for testing purposes.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m (odometer reading).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end. Formula: Supervised Distance (1000) - Distance Travelled (100) - Under-reading (5) = 895 m. The remaining distance from the max safe front end is 895 m.

steps.action: Check the remaining distance from the estimated front end.
steps.expected: Formula: Supervised Distance (1000) - Distance Travelled (100) = 900 m. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 900 m.

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Staff Responsible mode. The SR distance is 1000 m. The odometer has a known over-reading amount of 5 m since the supervision started.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance: 1000 m. Distance travelled (odometer): 100 m. Odometer under-reading: 0 m. Odometer over-reading: 5 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows setting or simulating odometer under/over-reading values for testing purposes.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m (odometer reading).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end. Formula: Supervised Distance (1000) - Distance Travelled (100) + Over-reading (5) = 905 m. The remaining distance from the min safe front end is 905 m.

steps.action: Check the remaining distance from the estimated front end.
steps.expected: Formula: Supervised Distance (1000) - Distance Travelled (100) = 900 m. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 900 m.

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision restart upon RBC update

The remaining distance is recalculated based on the new distance (500 m) and the distance travelled since the new start (0 m). The remaining distance is 500 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 50 m.

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision restart upon driver input

The remaining distance is recalculated based on the new distance (800 m) and the distance travelled since the new start (0 m). The remaining distance is 800 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m.

test_cases.title: Zero distance supervision after Override without valid position

steps.action: Trigger the Override function.
steps.expected: The OBU enters Staff Responsible mode. A virtual train front position is created for the zero distance to the former EOA/LOA. The remaining distance to the former EOA/LOA is 0 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the virtual position. The remaining distance to the former EOA/LOA becomes negative (-10 m), indicating the train has passed the former EOA/LOA. This will trigger a trip condition if Override is deactivated.

test_cases.title: Standstill supervision distance calculation

steps.action: Move the train forward by another 3 m (total 6 m).
steps.expected: The remaining distance becomes negative (-1 m), indicating the standstill limit has been exceeded. A safety reaction (e.g., brake application) should be triggered.

steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for all stored route suitability information.

test_cases.title: Resume initial state for Station Platform track conditions via single request

test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored track condition information of type Station Platform.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to the OBU to resume initial state for all stored track condition information of type Station Platform.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for all stored Station Platform track condition information.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with same orientation applies replacement rules
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with stored location based information. Train orientation is forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction matching the current train orientation (forward).

steps.action: Send a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation to the OBU with a validity direction matching the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 to the new information, replacing stored information as per the per-type rules.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite orientation deletes all location based information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with stored location based information. Train orientation is forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction opposite to the current train orientation (backward).

steps.action: Send a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation to the OBU with a validity direction opposite to the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the replacement rules of §3.7.3.1. Instead, it deletes all previously stored location based information.

test_cases.title: MA request includes single applicable reason
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC is established. No MA request reasons are currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selects 'Start'.

steps.action: Driver selects 'Start' on the DMI.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Start selected by driver' and no other reasons.

test_cases.title: MA request includes multiple applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC is established. The reason 'Start selected by driver' is currently active (e.g., driver selected Start previously and no MA received yet).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a track description deletion event (e.g., via RBC command or simulation) that is not in exceptions a, b, f, k.

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains both reasons: 'Start selected by driver' and 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A perturbation location is defined. The train is moving towards the perturbation location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed and position such that the train front passes the calculated trigger location d_MAR.
test_cases.assumptions: The trigger location d_MAR is calculated based on the formula in 3.13.11.8 and is ahead of the current train position.

steps.action: Move the train such that the train front passes the location d_MAR.
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A Section timer is active for a section in the current MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time elapsed such that the defined time before the Section timer expiration is reached.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer is running and the defined time before expiration is set by RBC parameters.

steps.action: Wait until the moment defined by the Section timer criterion is reached (i.e., time before expiration equals the defined value).
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion (valid situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC is established. Track description is present.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a command to delete a part of the track description corresponding to a situation in Appendix A.3.4 that is NOT a, b, f, or k (e.g., situation c).

steps.action: RBC sends a command to delete a part of the track description (situation c).
steps.expected: OBU deletes the specified part of the track description.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior after deletion.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request triggered by track description deletion (exception situation a)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC is established. Track description is present.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a command to delete a part of the track description corresponding to situation a in Appendix A.3.4.

steps.action: RBC sends a command to delete a part of the track description (situation a).
steps.expected: OBU deletes the specified part of the track description.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior after deletion.
steps.expected: OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior after deletion.
