test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing End Section timer start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving forward at a speed sufficient to cross the location within the test duration.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU status before the train's max safe front end reaches the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not running.

steps.action: Allow the train to move until its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts running.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The current EOA/LOA is ahead of the train's current position. A non-zero target speed is defined at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time-out value set to a short duration for testing (e.g., 5 seconds).
test_cases.assumptions: The train remains stationary or moves slowly enough that the current position does not change significantly during the timeout period.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer value to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific time stamp.
test_cases.assumptions: The system clock is synchronized with the RBC time.

steps.action: Receive a new MA message in Level 2.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the value of the time stamp of the message containing the MA.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides a new MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group containing MA information.
test_cases.assumptions: The train passes the first balise of the group.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passage over the first encountered balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The current authority is a LOA with a non-zero speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time-out value set to a short duration for testing.

steps.action: Wait for the LOA speed timer value to exceed the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location is defined as per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value.

steps.action: Allow the train to move until its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts running.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and time-out value 'infinite'.

steps.action: Allow the train to move until its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. An overlap exists with an associated release speed. A non-zero target speed is defined at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time-out value set to a short duration for testing.

steps.action: Wait for the Overlap timer value to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap information is deleted. The release speed associated with the Overlap is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer has been started. The train is moving.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer value as greater than its time-out value. The consequences defined for Overlap time-out (§3.8.4.4.2) are applied: overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero.

test_cases.title: New MA with Overlap start location in rear of max safe front end (no timer running)
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is currently running. The train is in Full Supervision.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location located in rear of the train's max safe front end.

steps.action: Receive a new MA where the Overlap timer start location is in rear of the max safe front end of the train.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer value has exceeded its time-out value. The consequences defined in §3.8.4.4.2 are applied: overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid Overlap
test_cases.preconditions: An overlap exists and has not timed out. A Danger Point exists. An End Section exists.

steps.action: Evaluate the Supervised Location (SvL) while the overlap is valid.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination without Overlap but with Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: No overlap exists (or it has timed out). A Danger Point exists. An End Section exists.

steps.action: Evaluate the Supervised Location (SvL) when no valid overlap exists but a Danger Point is present.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with only End Section
test_cases.preconditions: No overlap exists (or it has timed out). No Danger Point exists. An End Section exists.

steps.action: Evaluate the Supervised Location (SvL) when neither a valid overlap nor a Danger Point exists.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Full Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Automatic Driving mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Automatic Driving mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Limited Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in other modes
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode other than Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision (e.g., Supervision, Shunting, or Standstill).
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in a mode other than Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message referencing a main signal balise group with available linking info.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA where linking information is available for the referenced main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is NOT available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message referencing a main signal balise group without available linking info.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA where linking information is not available for the referenced main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA from RBC replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and supervising a valid MA received from a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message from RBC with different speed profiles and section lengths than the current MA.

steps.action: Transmit a new MA from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (sections, speeds, timers) is replaced by the data from the new RBC MA. No residual data from the previous MA remains.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA from main-signal balise group replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and supervising a valid MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message from a main-signal balise group (non-infill) with distinct section parameters.

steps.action: Pass the main-signal balise group transmitting the new non-infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA is replaced by the new data from the balise group. The MA structure starts from the current location reference.

test_cases.title: Infill MA replaces only data beyond the next main signal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode, supervising an MA that includes sections beyond the next main signal. Linking information for the next main signal is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message containing updated data for sections beyond the next main signal, while the data up to the next main signal remains consistent with the current MA.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the MA data up to the announced balise group at the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data up to the next main signal remains unchanged from the previous MA.

steps.action: Inspect the MA data beyond the announced balise group at the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data beyond the next main signal is replaced by the data from the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA starts new section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. Linking information for the next main signal is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message referencing the balise group at the next main signal.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the start location of the new MA section created by the infill.
steps.expected: The new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal.

test_cases.title: New MA with SvL while supervising LOA is treated as shortening
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA). Location-based information is stored on-board as per Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message defining a Supervised Location (SvL) at a location further than the current LOA end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the event as an MA shortening, despite the SvL being further than the previous LOA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The location-based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: New MA with SvL closer than LOA is treated as shortening
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message defining an SvL at a location closer than the current LOA end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining a closer SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the event as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The location-based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising an MA. Linking information announces a following balise group as unknown but containing repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information in a balise group message.

steps.action: Receive the repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the length of the current MA section.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the reception of repositioning information as an MA shortening. No deletion of location-based information occurs.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising an MA with a defined SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message that ends with a Limit of Authority (LOA).

steps.action: Receive the new MA ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA and starts supervising the LOA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the reception of this new MA as an MA shortening. No deletion of location-based information occurs.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Tren sınırı gerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili mod profili ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumunun gerisinde olacak şekilde ayarlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'inden geridedir.

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın İndication supervision limit'inden gerisinde olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği kabul eder ve önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı, varsa mod profilini ve SH alanı balise grubu listesini yeni MA olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin reddi (Tren sınırı ilerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili mod profili ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumunun ilerisinde olacak şekilde ayarlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'inden ileridedir.

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın İndication supervision limit'inden ileride olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği reddeder. Önceki MA, mod profili ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin reddedildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Tren sınırı tam sınırda)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili mod profili ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumuyla aynı olacak şekilde ayarlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'iyle aynıdır (sınırda). 'In rear' (geride) koşulu, sınırda olan durumu da kapsayacak şekilde yorumlanır veya sınır durumu kabul olarak test edilir. Standartlarda 'in rear' genellikle 'not in advance' olarak yorumlanır, ancak kesinlik için sınır durumu test edilir. Eğer 'in rear' strict olarak 'geride' ise bu test reddedilir. Ancak genellikle sınırda kabul edilir. Varsayım: Sınırda kabul edilir.

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın İndication supervision limit'iyle aynı konumda olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği kabul eder ve önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı yeni MA olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill ortamı talebinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 1'de çalışmaktadır ve daha önce geçerli bir hareket yetkisi (MA) ve konum bilgisi almıştır. OBU, radyo infill (RIU) donanımına sahip değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radyo infill talebi içeren bir duyuru balise grubu (announcement balise group).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun radyo infill donanımının bulunmadığı test ortamında yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU'ya, radyo infill ortamını talep eden bir duyuru balise grubu okutulur.
steps.expected: OBU, radyo infill donanımına sahip olmadığı için bu talebi yok sayar. Sistemde hata veya uyarı mesajı oluşmaz.

steps.action: Trenin mevcut hareket yetkisi ve hız profili gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Tren, duyuru balise grubundan önceki adımda alınan ve hâlâ geçerli olan hareket yetkisi ve konum bilgilerine göre çalışmaya devam eder. Hız profili veya frenleme davranışı değişmez.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. The OBU has received an order via a previous balise group to expect infill information from a loop for the next main signal balise group (NMBG). The train is approaching the NMBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill message containing movement authority data.
test_cases.assumptions: The loop infill unit is active and transmitting valid infill data.

steps.action: The train passes the NMBG balise group, and the OBU successfully reads the balise data.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the main signal information from the NMBG. The state of the OBU indicates that the NMBG has been read.

steps.action: The loop infill unit transmits a new infill message to the OBU after the NMBG has been read.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. The movement authority and speed profile remain unchanged based on the NMBG data, and no new infill data is integrated.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. The OBU has received an order via a previous balise group to expect infill information from a loop for the next main signal balise group (NMBG). The NMBG is physically present but unreadable or the OBU fails to read it (e.g., due to a fault or interference).
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill message containing movement authority data.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the expected NMBG was missed (e.g., based on position and time).

steps.action: The train passes the location of the NMBG, and the OBU detects that the NMBG was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the event of the missed NMBG. The OBU's state reflects that the NMBG was not read.

steps.action: The loop infill unit transmits a new infill message to the OBU after the detection of the missed NMBG.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. The movement authority and speed profile are not updated with the new infill data.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores RIU session order when GSM-R is not installed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured without a GSM-R radio system. The OBU is in Level 1 operation.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a specific RIU.

steps.action: The train reads a balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to establish a communication session with the RIU. No GSM-R connection is initiated.

test_cases.title: OBU switches RIU session upon reaching location with existing session
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1. An active communication session exists with RIU-A. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group order to establish a session with RIU-B, specifying a location ahead of the current position.

steps.action: The train reads the balise group order to establish a session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU acknowledges the order but maintains the session with RIU-A as the location has not yet been reached.

steps.action: The train reaches the location specified in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with RIU-A.

steps.action: The OBU attempts to establish a new session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: A communication session is established with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores RIU order in degraded single-session mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a degraded situation where it can handle only one GSM-R communication session. An active session exists with RIU-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order received via the active RIU-A to establish a session with RIU-B.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order via RIU-A to establish a communication session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. The session with RIU-A is maintained, and no session is established with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: OBU notifies RIU upon entering infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1. A session is established with an RIU. The OBU has received a balise order specifying an entry location and a Next Main Signal Balise Group (NMBG).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the specified entry location.

steps.action: The train passes the location indicated in the balise group order (entry of the infill area).
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating entry into the infill area.

test_cases.title: OBU notifies RIU upon reading NMBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an active infill area with an RIU. The NMBG identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement reading the NMBG.

steps.action: The train reads the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating that the NMBG has been read.

test_cases.title: OBU notifies RIU upon detecting missed NMBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an active infill area with an RIU. The NMBG identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the NMBG location without reading the balise (simulated miss).

steps.action: The OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating that the NMBG was missed.

test_cases.title: OBU sends required data fields to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an active infill area with an RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for sending information (e.g., passing entry location).

steps.action: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The transmitted message contains the Train Identity (ETCS-ID), a Position Report, the Identifier of the Next Main Signal Balise Group, and a Time Stamp.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects inconsistent radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an active infill area with an RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill data with inconsistent parameters (e.g., invalid speed profile or conflicting movement authority) as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3.

steps.action: The OBU receives radio infill data that fails consistency checks.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data and does not apply it to the movement authority or speed profile. An error or fault indication may be raised.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores infill data after NMBG read
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has read the NMBG indicated in the infill order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Further radio infill information related to the previously read NMBG.

steps.action: The OBU receives new infill information related to the NMBG that was just read.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received information. The movement authority and speed profile remain unchanged based on this specific data.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates RIU session on trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an active communication session with an RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A terminate session order received from a balise group or the RIU.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order to terminate the communication session from the trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the Radio Infill Unit.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates RIU session when leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active communication session with an RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to a different operational level (e.g., Level 2 or Level 0).

steps.action: The OBU transitions out of Level 1 operation.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the Radio Infill Unit.

test_cases.title: Emergency message acknowledgement with correct ID
test_cases.preconditions: An active radio communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid emergency stop message (e.g., Unconditional Emergency Stop) with a specific NID_EM value.

steps.action: Send an emergency message from the trackside to the OBU containing a unique identification number (NID_EM).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes it.

steps.action: Monitor the radio traffic for the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message (e.g., Message 147: Acknowledgement of Emergency Stop) that contains the same NID_EM value as the received emergency message.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of repeated emergency message with same ID
test_cases.preconditions: An active radio communication session is established. The OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with ID X.
test_cases.test_inputs: A repeated emergency message with the same identification number (NID_EM = X).

steps.action: Send a repeated emergency message from the trackside to the OBU using the same identification number (NID_EM) as the previously received message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the repeated message.

steps.action: Monitor the radio traffic for the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU in response to the repeated message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message quoting the same identification number (NID_EM) as the repeated emergency message.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of new emergency message with different ID
test_cases.preconditions: An active radio communication session is established. The OBU has previously acknowledged an emergency message with ID X.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new emergency message with a different identification number (NID_EM = Y, where Y != X).

steps.action: Send a new emergency message from the trackside to the OBU with a different identification number (NID_EM) than the previous one.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new message and replaces the previous emergency message state.

steps.action: Monitor the radio traffic for the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message quoting the new identification number (NID_EM = Y) of the current emergency message.

test_cases.title: Red movement authority rejected after accepted conditional emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A conditional emergency stop message with a stop location ahead of the train's minimum safe front end has been received and accepted. The emergency stop has not been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid movement authority (MA) message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send a new movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new movement authority. The current emergency stop state remains active.

test_cases.title: Red movement authority rejected after accepted unconditional emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. An unconditional emergency stop message has been received and accepted, causing the train to trip. The emergency stop has not been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid movement authority (MA) message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send a new movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new movement authority. The train remains in the tripped state associated with the emergency stop.

test_cases.title: Movement authority accepted after emergency stop revocation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has accepted a conditional emergency stop message. The emergency stop has not yet been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message for the emergency stop, followed by a new valid movement authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the active emergency stop.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the revocation. The emergency stop state is cleared.

steps.action: Send a new movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new movement authority, as the emergency stop is no longer active.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges emergency message revocation with correct timestamp
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages (e.g., FSD or OS). An emergency message with ID 'EM-1' has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message (Message 18) for emergency message ID 'EM-1' is sent from the RBC. The message contains a valid timestamp 'T_REV' and M_ACK=1.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio link is stable and the OBU is configured to send acknowledgements.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for emergency message ID 'EM-1' from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink radio traffic from the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU.
steps.expected: The acknowledgement message refers to the timestamp 'T_REV' of the revocation message sent by the trackside, as per SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.3.

test_cases.title: OBU does not acknowledge inconsistent revocation message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages. An emergency message with ID 'EM-2' has been previously received.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message for emergency message ID 'EM-2' is sent from the RBC, but the message is marked as inconsistent (e.g., invalid checksum or logical inconsistency in fields).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has logic to detect message inconsistency as defined in the SRS.

steps.action: Send an inconsistent revocation message for emergency message ID 'EM-2' from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message but identifies it as inconsistent.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink radio traffic from the OBU for a duration sufficient to cover the acknowledgement timeout.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an acknowledgement message for this specific revocation, in accordance with SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.1 ('unless this message is considered as inconsistent').

test_cases.title: On-Sight modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, On-Sight (OS) modundadır. Ulusal OS hız limiti 30 km/h olarak yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen MA'da OS hız limiti 20 km/h olarak tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından OS modu için 20 km/h hız limiti içeren bir MA alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, uygulanan hız limitini 20 km/h olarak belirler.

steps.action: Tren hızı 25 km/h'a çıkarılır.
steps.expected: OBU, hız limiti ihlali algılar ve frenleme prosedürünü başlatır (veya DMI'de hız limiti 20 km/h olarak gösterilir).

test_cases.title: Limited Supervision modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Limited Supervision (LS) modundadır. Ulusal LS hız limiti 100 km/h olarak yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen MA'da LS hız limiti 80 km/h olarak tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından LS modu için 80 km/h hız limiti içeren bir MA alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, uygulanan hız limitini 80 km/h olarak belirler.

steps.action: Tren hızı 90 km/h'a çıkarılır.
steps.expected: OBU, hız limiti ihlali algılar ve frenleme prosedürünü başlatır (veya DMI'de hız limiti 80 km/h olarak gösterilir).

test_cases.title: Shunting modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Shunting (SH) modundadır. Ulusal SH hız limiti 30 km/h olarak yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen MA'da SH hız limiti 15 km/h olarak tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından SH modu için 15 km/h hız limiti içeren bir MA alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, uygulanan hız limitini 15 km/h olarak belirler.

steps.action: Tren hızı 20 km/h'a çıkarılır.
steps.expected: OBU, hız limiti ihlali algılar ve frenleme prosedürünü başlatır (veya DMI'de hız limiti 15 km/h olarak gösterilir).

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı hız limiti ulusal değerden yüksek olduğunda öncelik
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, On-Sight (OS) modundadır. Ulusal OS hız limiti 30 km/h olarak yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen MA'da OS hız limiti 40 km/h olarak tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından OS modu için 40 km/h hız limiti içeren bir MA alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, uygulanan hız limitini 40 km/h olarak belirler.

steps.action: Tren hızı 35 km/h'a çıkarılır.
steps.expected: OBU, hız limiti ihlali algılamaz, frenleme başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: PBD hız kısıtlamasının ilk hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlaması için 'hız kısıtlaması yok' başlangıç durumundadır. Ray kenarı, geçerli bir PBD profili (başlangıç/bitiş, PBD mesafesi, acil fren, eğim) göndermeye hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen PBD profili verileri (ör. PBD=1000m, Acil Fren, Eğim=0%).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç hesaplamaları SUBSET-026 §3.11.11'e göre yapılmaktadır.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, OBU'ya PBD hız kısıtlaması için gerekli olan izin verilen frenleme mesafesi (PBD) verilerini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar ve bu kısıtlamayı aktif hale getirir. Hesaplanan hız değeri, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki eşitsizlikleri sağlayan ve 5 km/h'nin tam katlarına yuvarlanmış en yüksek hızdır.

test_cases.title: Girdi değişmediğinde PBD hız kısıtlamasının yeniden hesaplanmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlamasını zaten hesaplamış ve aktif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değişiklik içermeyen, aynı PBD profili verileri.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, OBU'ya mevcut PBD hız kısıtlamasının girdileriyle (PBD mesafesi, fren tipi, eğim, konumlar) tamamen aynı olan bir profil gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplamaz. Mevcut hız kısıtlama değeri ve konumları değişmeden kalır.

test_cases.title: PBD girdilerinden birinin değişmesiyle yeniden hesaplama
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlamasını zaten hesaplamış ve aktif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: PBD mesafesi değiştirilmiş yeni bir profil (ör. 1000m'den 800m'ye).

steps.action: Ray kenarı, PBD mesafesi farklı (daha kısa) olan yeni bir PBD profili gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlamasını yeni girdilere göre yeniden hesaplar. Yeni hesaplanan hız değeri, eski değerden daha düşük veya eşit olmalıdır (daha kısa frenleme mesafesi daha düşük hız gerektirir).

test_cases.title: PBD hesabında dönen kütle telafili eğim ve güvenli yavaşlamanın kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hesabı için gerekli tüm parametreleri (tren ağırlığı, dönen kütle faktörü vb.) içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Pozitif eğim (yokuş yukarı) içeren bir PBD profili.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.13.4.3'e göre dönen kütle telafisini ve §3.13.6.2.1'e göre güvenli yavaşlamayı (yapışma profilleri hariç) doğru uyguladığı varsayılır.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, pozitif eğim değeri içeren bir PBD profili gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, eğim değerini dönen kütle faktörüyle telafi eder. Hesaplanan PBD hız kısıtlaması, düz yolda aynı PBD mesafesi için hesaplanandan daha düşük olmalıdır (yokuş yukarıda frenleme mesafesi uzar, bu yüzden başlangıç hızı düşmelidir).

test_cases.title: PBD hesabında acil fren için EBD eğrisinin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hesabı için gerekli tüm parametreleri içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Acil fren ile PBD'ye ulaşılacak bir profil.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.13.6.2.1'e göre güvenli yavaşlamayı ve §3.11.11.4'e göre EBD eğrisini doğru oluşturur.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren ile sağlanacağını belirten bir profil gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli yavaşlamaya dayalı bir EBD eğrisi oluşturur. Bu eğri, izin verilen frenleme mesafesinde (d_PBD) sıfır hıza ulaşmalıdır. Hesaplanan PBD hızı, bu EBD eğrisi ve ilgili gecikmeler (T_traction, T_bere, T41) dikkate alınarak belirlenir.

test_cases.title: PBD hesabında servis freni için SBD ve EBD eğrilerinin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hesabı için gerekli tüm parametreleri içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Servis freni ile PBD'ye ulaşılacak bir profil.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.13.6.3.1'e göre beklenen yavaşlamayı ve §3.11.11.4'e göre SBD ve EBD eğrilerini doğru oluşturur.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin servis freni ile sağlanacağını belirten bir profil gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, hem beklenen yavaşlamaya dayalı bir SBD eğrisi hem de güvenli yavaşlamaya dayalı bir EBD eğrisi oluşturur. Her iki eğri de izin verilen frenleme mesafesinde (d_PBD) sıfır hıza ulaşmalıdır. Hesaplanan PBD hızı, bu iki eğri ve ilgili gecikmeler (T_bs1, T_bs2, T_traction, T_bere, T41) dikkate alınarak belirlenir.

test_cases.title: Acil fren PBD'si için EBD tabanlı eşitsizliklerin sağlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hesabı için gerekli tüm parametreleri içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Acil fren ile PBD'ye ulaşılacak, makul bir PBD mesafesi içeren profil.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki formülleri doğru uygular.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, acil fren ile PBD'ye ulaşılacak bir profil gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki iki eşitsizliği sağlayan V_PBD değerini bulur. Bu değer, 5 km/h'nin bir alt tam katına yuvarlanır. Sonuç, hem hız farkı (ABS) hem de mesafe (d_offset + D_bec) kısıtlamalarını karşılar.

test_cases.title: Acil fren PBD'si için eşitsizliklerin sağlanamaması durumunda sıfır hız
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hesabı için gerekli tüm parametreleri içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Çok kısa bir PBD mesafesi içeren profil (ör. 10m).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki formülleri doğru uygular.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, acil fren ile PBD'ye ulaşılacak ancak çok kısa (fiziksel olarak frenlenmeye izin vermeyen) bir PBD mesafesi içeren profil gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki eşitsizlikleri sağlayan bir hız bulamaz. Bu durumda, PBD hız kısıtlaması (V_PBD) 0 olarak ayarlanır.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored in the on-board data. The train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 100 km/h. Distance to tunnel stopping area start (Point D) is set such that the estimated front end reaches the announcement trigger point (Point C).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU based on current speed and driver reaction time as per Appendix A.3.1. The announcement trigger point C is located rear of Point D.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the location (Point C) in rear of the beginning of the tunnel stopping area (Point D).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the start location (Point D) of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is no longer displayed, and the 'Tunnel stopping area' information is displayed to the driver.

test_cases.title: Sound horn area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A sound horn track condition area is stored in the on-board data. The train is moving towards the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 80 km/h. Distance to sound horn area start (Point D) is set such that the estimated front end reaches the trigger point (Point C).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU based on current speed and driver reaction time. The trigger point C is located rear of Point D.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the location (Point C) in rear of the beginning of the sound horn area (Point D).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Sound horn' indication to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the end location (Point E) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of tunnel stopping area start with high speed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored. The train is moving at a high speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 200 km/h. The distance to Point D is adjusted so that the estimated front end (which accounts for higher speed and reaction time) reaches Point C at a specific distance.
test_cases.assumptions: At higher speeds, the distance between Point C and Point D increases to account for the longer reaction time and braking distance required for the driver to perform the action.

steps.action: Set the train speed to 200 km/h and move the train towards the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the estimated front end position based on the 200 km/h speed.

steps.action: Observe the point where the 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is displayed.
steps.expected: The announcement is displayed when the estimated front end reaches Point C, which is further away from Point D compared to a lower speed scenario, reflecting the increased reaction time.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of sound horn area end with low speed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A sound horn area is stored. The train is moving at a low speed within the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 10 km/h. The train is inside the sound horn area, approaching Point E.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is used to determine when the train has passed the end of the sound horn area (Point E).

steps.action: Move the train at 10 km/h such that the estimated front end is just before Point E (end of sound horn area).
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is still displayed.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end passes Point E.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Loading gauge mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Valid Train Data is stored with Loading Gauge 'G1'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route Suitability Data from trackside: Permitted Loading Gauges = ['G2', 'G3'].

steps.action: Receive Route Suitability Data from trackside specifying permitted loading gauges that do not include the train's stored loading gauge.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a loading gauge unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist and informs the driver about the loading gauge unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Axle load category mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Valid Train Data is stored with Axle Load Category 'AL1'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route Suitability Data from trackside: Permitted Axle Load Categories = ['AL2', 'AL3'].

steps.action: Receive Route Suitability Data from trackside specifying permitted axle load categories that do not include the train's stored axle load category.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an axle load category unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist and informs the driver about the axle load category unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Traction system mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Valid Train Data is stored with Traction System 'TS1'. The engine is NOT capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route Suitability Data from trackside: Required Traction System = 'TS2'.

steps.action: Receive Route Suitability Data from trackside specifying a traction system that is not among those accepted by the engine.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a traction system unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist and informs the driver about the traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: All parameters match
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Valid Train Data is stored with Loading Gauge 'G1', Axle Load 'AL1', Traction System 'TS1'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route Suitability Data from trackside: Permitted Loading Gauges = ['G1', 'G2'], Permitted Axle Loads = ['AL1', 'AL2'], Required Traction System = 'TS1'.

steps.action: Receive Route Suitability Data from trackside where all parameters match the stored Train Data.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and finds no unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status.
steps.expected: The OBU does not report any route suitability unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Traction system exception: Engine can run without traction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Valid Train Data is stored with Traction System 'TS1'. The engine IS capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route Suitability Data from trackside: Required Traction System = 'TS2' (or 'None' if applicable, but specifically a system not accepted by the engine).

steps.action: Receive Route Suitability Data from trackside specifying a traction system that is not among those accepted by the engine.
steps.expected: The OBU checks the engine capability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status regarding traction system suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT find a traction system unsuitability, despite the mismatch, because the engine can run on a line without any traction system.

test_cases.title: No route suitability data received: Initial state
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No Route Suitability Data has been received from trackside since the last reset or transition.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (absence of data).

steps.action: Operate the train in an area where no Route Suitability Data is transmitted by trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU internal state for route suitability supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values. The state indicates that no route suitability restriction exists.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages can be displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'no driver acknowledgement requested'.

steps.action: Transmit a text message from trackside with class 'auxiliary information' and no driver acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for auxiliary information without acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages can be displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'important information' and 'driver acknowledgement requested'.

steps.action: Transmit a text message from trackside with class 'important information' and driver acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for important information with acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) and Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0 (OR logic).

steps.action: Transmit a text message with two start sub-conditions and Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message and waits for start condition.

steps.action: Fulfill only the first start sub-condition.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the text message.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) and Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1 (AND logic).

steps.action: Transmit a text message with two start sub-conditions and Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message and waits for start condition.

steps.action: Fulfill only the first start sub-condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the text message.

steps.action: Fulfill the second start sub-condition while the first is still fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the text message.

test_cases.title: Start condition with no sub-conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Transmit a text message with no start sub-conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately displays the text message.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: A text message with driver acknowledgement request is displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with driver acknowledgement request, configured such that acknowledgement always ends display.

steps.action: Display a text message with driver acknowledgement request where acknowledgement is defined to always end display.
steps.expected: The message is displayed and waiting for acknowledgement.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text message display ends immediately.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement as necessary condition for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: A text message with driver acknowledgement request is displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with driver acknowledgement request, configured such that acknowledgement is a necessary condition in addition to end condition.

steps.action: Display a text message with driver acknowledgement request where acknowledgement is a necessary condition in addition to end condition.
steps.expected: The message is displayed and waiting for acknowledgement and end condition.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text message remains displayed.

steps.action: Fulfill the end condition.
steps.expected: The text message display ends.

test_cases.title: No display if end condition is immediately fulfilled
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start condition fulfilled immediately and end condition already fulfilled.

steps.action: Transmit a text message where the start condition is fulfilled immediately and the end condition is already fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the text message.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start condition including location and end condition including location.

steps.action: Transmit a text message with start condition including location A and end condition including location B.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the text message starting at location A.

steps.action: Move the train from location A to location B.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed for the length between location A and location B.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with driver acknowledgement request and report to RBC enabled.

steps.action: Transmit a text message with driver acknowledgement request and report to RBC enabled.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the text message.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report including the text message identifier to the RBC referenced in the request.

test_cases.title: Reject new text message with same identifier as unacknowledged message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a text message with driver acknowledgement request and report to RBC enabled, which is not yet acknowledged.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with the same text message identifier as the unacknowledged message.

steps.expected: The OBU displays the text message.

steps.action: Transmit a new text message with the same identifier X and driver acknowledgement request and report to RBC enabled.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile OS Mode Profile'ın kısmi silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve bu MA'ya bağlı bir On Sight (OS) Mode Profile'ı denetlemektedir. Tren, Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının ötesinde, infill referans noktasının öncesinde bir konumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA mesajı (infill referans noktası, mevcut OS Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının ötesinde).
test_cases.assumptions: Infill referans noktası, mevcut OS Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasından sonra ve sonundan önce bir konumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'ya infill referans noktası mevcut OS Mode Profile'ın ortasında olan bir infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, infill referans noktasının öncesindeki OS Mode Profile bölümünü korur ve infill referans noktasının ötesindeki OS Mode Profile bölümünü siler.

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Infill referans noktasının öncesinde OS modu denetimi devam eder, ötesinde ise yeni MA'ya göre denetim yapılır.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile SH Mode Profile'ın silinmesi (Referans başlangıçta veya gerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve bu MA'ya bağlı bir Shunting (SH) Mode Profile'ı denetlemektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA mesajı (infill referans noktası, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasında veya gerisinde).

steps.action: OBU'ya infill referans noktası mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasında olan bir infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ı tamamen siler.

steps.action: OBU'ya infill referans noktası mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının gerisinde olan bir infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ı tamamen siler.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile SH Mode Profile'ın korunması (Referans başlangıcın ötesinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve bu MA'ya bağlı bir Shunting (SH) Mode Profile'ı denetlemektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA mesajı (infill referans noktası, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının ötesinde; infill MA içinde yeni bir Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi içeriyor).

steps.action: OBU'ya infill referans noktası mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasının ötesinde olan ve yeni bir Mode Profile içeren bir infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ı silmez ve infill MA içindeki yeni Mode Profile'ı ile SH balise grubu listesini yok sayar (ignore).

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Mevcut SH Mode Profile'ı denetimi devam eder.

test_cases.title: Geçici EOA ve SvL: Profile geçici SvL gerektiriyorsa
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçiş yapmadığı bir Mode Profile'ı almıştır. Mode Profile, geçici SvL gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile (başlangıç konumu, geçici SvL gereksinimi: Evet).

steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumunu geçici EOA olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim sınırları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumunda, serbest bırakma hızı (release speed) olmadan geçici SvL olarak ele alır.

test_cases.title: Geçici EOA ve SvL: Profile geçici SvL gerektirmiyorsa ve MA'da LOA varsa (LOA profile başlangıcında veya ötesinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçiş yapmadığı bir Mode Profile'ı almıştır. Mode Profile, geçici SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA, bir LOA (Limit of Authority) tanımlamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile (başlangıç konumu, geçici SvL gereksinimi: Hayır), MA (LOA konumu: Mode Profile başlangıcında veya ötesinde).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5'e göre LOA yokmuş gibi hesaplanan konum, Mode Profile başlangıcından farklıdır.

steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumunu geçici EOA olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim sınırları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5'e göre LOA yokmuş gibi hesaplanan konumda, serbest bırakma hızı olmadan geçici SvL olarak ele alır.

test_cases.title: Geçici EOA ve SvL: Profile geçici SvL gerektirmiyorsa ve MA'da LOA varsa (LOA profile başlangıcının gerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçiş yapmadığı bir Mode Profile'ı almıştır. Mode Profile, geçici SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA, bir LOA (Limit of Authority) tanımlamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile (başlangıç konumu, geçici SvL gereksinimi: Hayır), MA (LOA konumu: Mode Profile başlangıcının gerisinde).

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile'ı ve LOA içeren MA'yı alır, ilgili moda geçiş yapmaz.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumunu geçici EOA olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim sınırları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile'ın başlangıç konumunda, serbest bırakma hızı olmadan geçici SvL olarak ele alır.

test_cases.title: Yeni LX bilgisinin aynı kimlikli eski LX bilgisini değiştirmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, kimliği 'LX-001' olan ve belirli bir uzunluk/koruma durumuna sahip bir LX bilgisini zaten depolamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kimliği 'LX-001' olan, ancak farklı uzunluk veya koruma durumuna sahip yeni bir LX profili verisi.

steps.action: Kimliği 'LX-001' olan yeni LX bilgisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni LX bilgisini kabul eder ve depolanan eski 'LX-001' LX bilgisini yeni bilgilerle değiştirir.

steps.action: Depolanan LX bilgileri incelenir.
steps.expected: Sistemde 'LX-001' kimliğine sahip tek bir LX kaydı bulunur ve bu kaydın değerleri yeni iletilen LX bilgisiyle eşleşir.

test_cases.title: Farklı kimlikli LX bilgisinin mevcut LX bilgisini etkilememesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, kimliği 'LX-001' olan bir LX bilgisini depolamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kimliği 'LX-002' olan yeni bir LX profili verisi.

steps.action: Kimliği 'LX-002' olan yeni LX bilgisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni LX bilgisini kabul eder.

steps.action: Depolanan LX bilgileri incelenir.
steps.expected: Sistemde hem 'LX-001' hem de 'LX-002' kimliklerine sahip LX kayıtları bulunur. 'LX-001' kaydı değişmemiştir, 'LX-002' kaydı yeni bilgilerle eklenmiştir.

test_cases.title: AAL2 için phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneğinin sunulması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama gerektiren bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı tanımlıdır.
test_cases.assumptions: Phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama yöntemi (ör. FIDO2/WebAuthn) sistemde yapılandırılmış ve etkinleştirilmiştir.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi hesabıyla AAL2 seviyesinde oturum açma işlemi başlatılır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama ekranında en az bir phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneği (ör. FIDO2/WebAuthn) sunulur.

steps.action: Sunulan phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneği kullanılarak kimlik doğrulama tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde yetkilendirilmiş bir oturuma erişir.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with multi-factor authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A registered company representative account exists with a multi-factor authenticator (e.g., hardware token with biometric) enrolled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the multi-factor authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate login as a company representative using the multi-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the activation factor (e.g., biometric scan or PIN) associated with the multi-factor authenticator.

steps.action: Provide the valid activation factor to the multi-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The system verifies the possession and control of the authenticator and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with two separate factors
test_cases.preconditions: A registered company representative account exists with two separate authentication factors (e.g., password and OTP) enrolled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password and valid one-time password (OTP).
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate login as a company representative and enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second authentication factor (OTP).

steps.action: Enter the valid OTP.
steps.expected: The system verifies both factors and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with single factor only
test_cases.preconditions: A registered company representative account exists with two separate authentication factors (e.g., password and OTP) enrolled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password, no OTP provided.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate login as a company representative and enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second authentication factor (OTP).

steps.action: Do not provide the OTP and attempt to proceed or submit the form without the second factor.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating that a second factor is required.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with invalid second factor
test_cases.preconditions: A registered company representative account exists with two separate authentication factors (e.g., password and OTP) enrolled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password, invalid OTP.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate login as a company representative and enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second authentication factor (OTP).

steps.action: Enter an invalid OTP.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating an invalid second factor.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda inaktivite zaman aşımının tetiklenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 güvenlik seviyesinde kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi (örneğin 1 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum açıldıktan sonra, kullanıcı tarafından herhangi bir etkileşim (tıklama, klavye girişi, sayfa yenileme) yapılmadan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin dolması beklenir.
steps.expected: Zaman aşımı süresi dolduğunda sistem, oturumu sonlandırır ve kullanıcıyı kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirir.

steps.action: Oturum sonlandıktan sonra, kullanıcı doğrudan bir korumalı sayfaya erişmeye çalışır.
steps.expected: Erişim reddedilir ve kullanıcı yeniden kimlik doğrulaması yapmaya zorlanır.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda genel (overall) zaman aşımının tetiklenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 güvenlik seviyesinde kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamıştır. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan genel zaman aşımı süresi (örneğin 24 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için genel zaman aşımı süresinin 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum açıldıktan sonra, inaktivite zaman aşımını sıfırlamak için düzenli aralıklarla (örneğin her 30 dakikada bir) kullanıcı etkileşimi sağlanır, ancak genel zaman aşımı süresinin dolması beklenir.
steps.expected: Genel zaman aşımı süresi dolduğunda, inaktivite zaman aşımı sıfırlanmış olsa bile sistem oturumu sonlandırır.

steps.action: Oturum sonlandıktan sonra, kullanıcı mevcut oturum bilgilerini kullanarak bir işlem yapmaya çalışır.
steps.expected: İşlem reddedilir ve kullanıcı yeniden kimlik doğrulaması yapmaya yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Kullanıcı etkileşiminin inaktivite zaman aşımını sıfırlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 güvenlik seviyesinde aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi dolmak üzeredir.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin dolmasına kısa bir süre kala (örneğin 59. dakikada), kullanıcı sayfada bir tıklama veya klavye girişi yaparak etkileşimde bulunur.
steps.expected: Sistem, inaktivite zaman aşımı sayacını sıfırlar ve oturum devam eder.

steps.action: Etkileşimden sonra, yeni inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin dolması beklenir.
steps.expected: Yeni süre dolduğunda oturum sonlandırılır.

test_cases.title: Başarılı yeniden kimlik doğrulamanın her iki zaman aşımını sıfırlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 güvenlik seviyesinde aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. Hem inaktivite hem de genel zaman aşımı süreleri kısmen tüketilmiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için inaktivite zaman aşımının 1 saat, genel zaman aşımının 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum sırasında, sistem tarafından istenen periyodik yeniden kimlik doğrulama (reauthentication) işlemi başarılı bir şekilde tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Sistem, hem inaktivite zaman aşımı hem de genel zaman aşımı sayaçlarını sıfırlar.

steps.action: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama sonrası, inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin dolması beklenir.
steps.expected: Oturum, sıfırlanan inaktivite süresi dolana kadar açık kalır.

test_cases.title: Zaman aşımı dolmadan önce kullanıcıya uyarı verilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 güvenlik seviyesinde aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi dolmak üzeredir.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te, zaman aşımı dolmadan önce kullanıcıya uyarı verilmesi ve oturumu aktif tutma veya yeniden kimlik doğrulama seçeneği sunulması öngörülmektedir.

steps.action: Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin dolmasına kısa bir süre kala (örneğin son 1 dakikada), kullanıcıya oturumun sonlanacağına dair bir uyarı mesajı gösterilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya, oturumu aktif tutmak için etkileşimde bulunma veya yeniden kimlik doğrulama yapma seçeneği sunulur.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, uyarı penceresinde 'Oturumu Devam Ettir' seçeneğini seçer.
steps.expected: Inaktivite zaman aşımı sayacı sıfırlanır ve oturum devam eder.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to designee

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to representative
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with the representative's own notification address configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the company representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports account recovery and has a mechanism to send notifications to configured addresses.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The account recovery is successful.
